label: რუკა
about: The Cartographer: the place is the explanation; the camera flies through one map.
brief: The film is about where it happens: the real map of Georgia carries the story.
First 2 s: the hook names the place and what happens there.
Then the map: one where scene per place the articles name (a second where scene flies to the next place).
After the map, one scene says what happens there (a sign, steps or a time span).
Name places exactly as the articles do; never a place they don't name.
Crime stories stop at the region: no district, no street.
The viewer leaves knowing where, and whether it touches them.
pacing: the map scenes get the most time; the camera carries the cuts.
